newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-HENRY CLAIMS REAL MADRID FORGED HIS SIGNATURE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HENRY CLAIMS REAL MADRID FORGED HIS SIGNATURE.

text.p: Monaco's teenage winger Thierry Henry claims that Real Madrid forged his signature on a document in which he is said to have agreed to join the Spanish club.
"What the player has always asserted to us is that the Spanish counterfeited his signature," Monaco's general manager Henri Biancheri said on Thursday.
"It's therefore down to the Spanish to put forward the proof," he added.
Henry was quoted earlier this week by Spanish newspapers as saying Real Madrid, who maintain the player signed a pre-contract in January, had forged his signature.
Biancheri said Monaco had not had any contact with Henry since he went to Malaysia with the French team for the world youth championship which ended last weekend. Henry is on holiday until July 15.
"In any case, as far as we are concerned we have a contract signed by him on January 6, 1997. And Thierry had a contract as an apprentice with Monaco until 1998."

Real claim that they met Henry in Nice in January -- it is unclear whether the player was alone or with an agent or relative -- and he signed an agreement with them. They said they had lodged the claim with the Spanish federation on January 13.
